Reverse trick: reverse all, then first k, then rest. O(n).

For rotate array basic I will triple-reverse.

```python
def rotate(nums, k):
    n = len(nums); k %= n
    nums[:] = nums[::-1]
    nums[:k] = nums[:k][::-1]
    nums[k:] = nums[k:][::-1]
```
